[[File:Carotid Fractal.png|thumb|right|Carotid-Kundalini function]]
The '''Carotid–Kundalini [[function (mathematics)|function]]''' is closely associated with '''Carotid-Kundalini [[fractals]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Carotid function |url=http://paulbourke.net/fractals/carotid |website=paulbourke.net}}</ref>''' coined by popular science columnist [[Clifford A. Pickover]] and it is defined as follows:<ref>{{cite web |last1=Weisstein |first1=Eric W. |title=Carotid-Kundalini Function |url=http://mathworld.wolfram.com/Carotid-KundaliniFunction.html |website=mathworld.wolfram.com |language=en}}</ref>

: <math>CK(n,x)=\cos(nx\arccos(x))</math>
